CVE-2026-5199 was introduced upstream in Temporal Server v1.29.0 and later fixed in v1.29.5 and v1.30.3. This VEX applies only to the 1.28.4 server packages shipped in this image: that release line predates the vulnerable batch activity implementation entirely, so the affected code was never present in these binaries.

CVE-2023-42821 was fixed upstream in github.com/gomarkdown/markdown at 0.0.0-20230922105210-14b16010c2ee. This image was updated to ship github.com/gomarkdown/markdown@0.0.0-20260411013819-759bbc3e3207 for the temporal CLI, which is newer than the upstream fix and therefore already contains the remediation. The vulnerable parser.Mmark citation parsing code from pre-fix versions is not present in the package version shipped here.

The vulnerability scanner incorrectly flags zlib packages as vulnerable when the untgz utility is not actually present in the installed packages.
